daily_lesson.explanation_en: Sector rotation is when investors move money from one group of industries into another instead of buying or selling the whole market. On days like today, the overall index can look flat while certain sectors, such as cybersecurity software, quietly rally. Spotting these rotations helps you find strong stocks even when the broad market isn't moving much.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 板塊輪動是指投資者將資金由一類行業轉移至另一類行業，而非整體買入或沽出大市。好像今日這類日子，指數表面上原地踏步，但個別板塊（例如網絡安全軟件股）卻悄悄走強。懂得留意板塊輪動，即使大市橫行，亦能發掘到表現強勁的個股。

market_education.summary_en: Today the market was split: tech-heavy NASDAQ names edged up while the broader S&P 500 dipped slightly, so there was no strong push in either direction. Money shifted between sectors rather than leaving the market, and several cybersecurity and software names (RBRK, TENB, CRWD, PANW, OKTA) showed strong momentum with above-average volume. No specific news headlines were provided today, so this explanation is based only on price and volume data.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢分歧，以科技股為主的納斯達克指數輕微上揚，標普500指數則小幅回落，整體欠缺明確方向。資金主要在板塊之間輪動，並非撤離股市，其中網絡安全及軟件股（如RBRK、TENB、CRWD、PANW、OKTA）動能強勁，成交量亦高於平均水平。由於今日未有提供具體新聞標題，以上分析僅根據價格及成交量數據。
